observations: Three photos show a used car engine in a junkyard or auto parts shop setting.
The engine has a silver-colored block, black plastic covers, and various hoses, belts, and pulleys attached.
Photo 0 shows the front of the engine with a large black intake hose, a silver heat shield, and a crankshaft pulley with a black center.
Photo 1 shows the top and side of the engine with an orange wrench resting on it, and a blue-painted wall with graffiti in the background.
Photo 2 shows the front and side with the alternator, serpentine belt, and pulley system visible. A blue cap is on a fluid reservoir.
The engine appears to be a complete unit with many components still attached, including the intake manifold, throttle body, and various sensors and connectors.
There is no visible branding or model number on the engine block or any part in any photo.
The seller claims it is for a Hyundai Santa Fe 2014, but no such label or marking is visible in the photos.
The engine shows signs of use: dirt, grime, and some rust on metal parts, especially on the heat shield and exhaust manifold.
